runs.question: How long do CFO Act agencies have to publish an AI strategy under the OMB AI memos?

answer.text:
Under the current OMB memo, CFO Act agencies have **180 days** from issuance to develop an AI strategy. OMB M-25-21 (April 2025) sets that deadline: within 180 days of the issuance of this memorandum, each CFO Act agency must develop an AI Strategy for identifying and removing barriers to their responsible use of AI and for achieving enterprise-wide improvements in the maturity of their applications. Agencies must also release the strategy publicly, using a template OMB will provide.

The earlier memo, OMB M-24-10 (March 2024), gave a longer window. Its strategy requirement ran within 365 days of the issuance of this memorandum. The documents I searched do not state explicitly that M-25-21 replaces M-24-10, but the newer 180-day deadline is the one in the more recent memo.

support.reason: Passage from OMB M-25-21 page 5 states the 180-day deadline and the same strategy requirement verbatim.
OMB M-24-10 passage states the 365-day window for the CFO Act agency AI strategy requirement.
